Package dev.gmitch215.bytebox.locks

Class AtomicLongArray

java.lang.Object
dev.gmitch215.bytebox.locks.AtomicLongArray
public class AtomicLongArray extends Object
java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLongArray, which the class library does not carry even though it carries AtomicLong.

Indivisible for the same reason as AtomicReferenceArray: one fiber runs at a time and none of these operations suspends, so no two of them interleave.

Since:
1.0.2
